reviews.summary: Skill performs well. 100% pass rate with skill vs 92% without. Key differentiator is collaboration style diagnosis and 'where human makes things worse' section. Moderate delta because three-path comparison is a general concept Claude handles reasonably well without a skill.
strengths: Two-mode design (Coach/Output) is well-specified and correctly triggers Output for actionable scenarios
Collaboration Style Diagnosis section is consistently produced with-skill, inconsistently without
Edge case handling (eval 3: self-review where solo may be better) correctly avoids defaulting to 'collaboration always wins'
'Where human intervention makes things worse' section enforces honesty — a differentiator absent from without-skill outputs
improvements: Coach Mode was not tested — only Output Mode evals exist. Add an eval that triggers Coach Mode to verify the experiential pathway works.
The Thinking Scorecard section from SKILL.md was not produced in any with-skill output. Consider whether it should be default output or only on-demand.

Eval 1 showed near-identical pass rates (6/6 both). Consider adding a more discriminating business eval — e.g., a task where pure AI is clearly sufficient and the skill should recommend AGAINST collaboration.
